Name: The Salt Road
Summary: A treacherous sea route covered in toxic salt fog that no mapmaker has survived charting.
Rules / Lore: The fog thickens with intent; compasses spin; only saltglass lenses reveal the safe channel.
Sensory Details: Stinging air, white haze, the taste of brine on every breath.
Significance to Plot: The central journey and the antagonist-as-setting.

Name: The Cartographers' Guild
Summary: An ancient order that controls all official maps and the power that comes with them.
Rules / Lore: To alter a map without sanction is treason. Rank is everything.
Sensory Details: Wax seals, vellum, the scratch of a hundred quills.
Significance to Plot: Drives Maren's disgrace and her motivation to return.

Name: Saltglass
Summary: Lenses ground from sea-hardened glass that let the holder see through the fog.
Rules / Lore: Rare and expensive; cracks if it touches fresh water; dims with overuse.
Sensory Details: A faint blue shimmer, cold to the touch.
Significance to Plot: The crew's only navigation tool — its fragility is a ticking clock.

Name: Vael Harbor
Summary: The exile city that cast Maren out; built on stilts above the tide.
Rules / Lore: Governed by the Guild; tides dictate the daily rhythm.
Sensory Details: Creaking wood, gull cries, lamplight on black water.
Significance to Plot: Home she must earn her way back into.

Name: The Hollow Works
Summary: A dying manufacturing town built around one enormous factory.
Rules / Lore: The factory 'remembers' — old machines run themselves at night.
Sensory Details: Rust, oil, the hum of dormant motors.
Significance to Plot: The hidden engine behind the three characters' linked fates.
